comment: Ink outline over the finished frame (assets/shaders/terrain_core/outline.hlsl), after the picture style and before the PSX look: dark, uneven lines on silhouettes (a neighbour `width` pixels away farther by more than `depth_edge` of the distance) and creases (relative second difference over `crease_edge`, weighted by `crease_strength`). `roughness` 0..1 makes the stroke breathe, wobble and break like dry ink; strength falls from 1 at `fade_start` to `far_strength` at `fade_end` metres. `ink` is the line's colour (sRGB 0..1), `ink_show_through` how much of the picture's colour stays under it. A style profile: `enabled` is the start state; the lab and the game toggle it with L (and read this file again) or --outline / --no-outline.
